newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weak, more gasoline seen sailing west.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weak, more gasoline seen sailing west.

text.p: NWE gasoline was weaker on Thursday as futures slipped back, traders said.
A refiner was heard having bought a cargo of mixed 98/88 unleaded gasoline into France but no more details were known.

Total September-loading European gasoline exports to the United States were now estimated at 500,000 tonnes with one cargo loading out of Venspils and at least two others out of NWE, in addition to 300,000 tonnes earlier reported.
U.S. numbers were not thought currently attractive.
